clue.text: Gershwin arrangement has people complaining

indicators.note: a musical arrangement reworks a piece, so the composer's name is rearranged here

explanation.surface: A new version of a Gershwin tune has listeners grumbling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arrangement' rearranges the eight letters of GERSHWIN; 'has' links wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Whingers is British slang for moaners, those who keep grumbling.

clue.text: Festival week was initially a success

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word week

parts.note: a hit is a success, like a hit record

explanation.surface: The week of the festival was a triumph from the start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes the first letter of 'week'; 'was' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Whit, or Whitsun, is the Christian feast of Pentecost, a church festival.

clue.text: At home match, makes smooth pastries with bursts of energy

parts.note: at home means in, as in staying in
to fit is to match, as a key fits a lock
sands means makes smooth with sandpaper
tarts are pastries

explanation.surface: Someone at a home game smooths out pastry dough in sudden spurts of activity.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in fits and starts means working in irregular spurts rather than steadily.

clue.text: Maxim possibly stung him badly

explanation.surface: A wise saying stung a man painfully.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Maxim' looks like a proverb, but it is Hiram Maxim, inventor of the Maxim machine gun; 'possibly' marks him as one example.
explanation.definitionFit: Hiram Maxim designed and built guns, so he is an example of a gun maker.

clue.text: Sorry I called round!

explanation.walkthrough: 'round' puts the I inside RUNG; 'Sorry' is used in the sense of regretful.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruing something means regretting it, being sorry about it.

clue.text: Tanker gives way to QE2

explanation.walkthrough: QE2 suggests the famous liner, but here it is the monarch Elizabeth II, whose cipher is ER; 'to' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A bowser is a mobile tanker, used for fuel or water, especially at airfields.

clue.text: Half the ground is in state to continue playing

explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is a link word. The definition reads as a football ruling: a player not offside may carry on.
explanation.definitionFit: A player who is onside, not offside, is in a legal position to carry on playing.

clue.text: Dim in a town house — light at first kept going off

indicators.note: going off suggests something spoiling or exploding, so the letters scatter

explanation.definitionFit: Someone slow on the uptake is slow to understand, which is what dim means.

clue.text: Again make declaration about a drink's properties

explanation.definitionFit: Real estate is land and buildings, that is, property holdings.

clue.text: Fashionable cool hat in early stage of development
